#### func (Assembly) OnWrite

```go

```

OnWrite sets a function called with the new data whenever an originator writes the assembly, by an I/O connection (with its run/idle state) or by Set\_Attribute\_Single (run true). It is called on a server goroutine and must not block; data is only valid during the call.

#### func (Assembly) Run


Run reports whether the last data consumed from a connection said run (output assemblies; false before the first datagram and after the connection closed).

SetData replaces the data; it must be exactly Size octets. Connections producing the assembly send it from their next interval on.

### type AssemblyKind

```go
type AssemblyKind uint8
```

AssemblyKind is the role of an assembly instance in I/O connections.

```go
const (
	// AssemblyInput is produced by the server (T->O): the application
	// sets its data, originators read it.
	AssemblyInput AssemblyKind = iota + 1
	// AssemblyOutput is consumed by the server (O->T): originators write
	// it, the application reads it. One connection owns it at a time
	// (exclusive owner).
	AssemblyOutput
	// AssemblyConfig receives the configuration data of Forward_Open.
	AssemblyConfig
	// AssemblyInputOnly is the heartbeat connection point of input-only
	// connections: an O->T point without data.
	AssemblyInputOnly
	// AssemblyListenOnly is the heartbeat connection point of listen-only
	// connections, which only join an existing multicast T->O production.
	AssemblyListenOnly
)
```

Assembly kinds.


### type Object

```go
type Object interface {
	// Class returns the class code.
	Class() cip.Class
	// ServeCIP handles a request addressed to the class or one of its
	// instances and returns the response; its Service is set by the
	// router. r.Data is only valid until ServeCIP returns: it aliases the

	ServeCIP(ctx context.Context, r *Request) cip.Response
```

Object is a CIP object class the Message Router dispatches requests to. ServeCIP is called from the goroutine of the session that received the request, concurrently for different sessions: an Object must be safe for concurrent use.

### type Option

```go
type Option func(*options) error
```

Option configures a [Server](#type-server).

#### func WithDiscoveryDelay

```go
func WithDiscoveryDelay(max time.Duration) Option
```

WithDiscoveryDelay bounds the random delay before answering a ListIdentity received over UDP, which the request may ask for in its sender context. Zero (the default) answers immediately.

#### func WithIOAddress

```go
func WithIOAddress(addr string) Option
```

WithIOAddress sets the UDP address of implicit messaging; the default is port 2222 on the host of the explicit address. ":0" picks a free port, which the server then announces in a Sockaddr Info item of its Forward\_Open replies.

#### func WithIdentity

```go
func WithIdentity(id cip.Identity) Option
```

WithIdentity sets the identity the Identity object and ListIdentity report. The product name is at most 32 characters; State 0 is reported as 3 (operational).

#### func WithInactivityTimeout

```go
func WithInactivityTimeout(d time.Duration) Option
```

WithInactivityTimeout closes a TCP connection that sends nothing for d (the encapsulation inactivity timeout, TCP/IP Interface attribute 13). Zero disables it. Default 120 seconds. Attribute 13 changes it at run time; each connection takes the new value from its next packet on.

#### func WithInterface

```go
func WithInterface(i Interface) Option
```

WithInterface sets what the TCP/IP Interface and Ethernet Link objects report, and the address in ListIdentity replies.

#### func WithLogger

```go
func WithLogger(l ethernetip.Logger) Option
```

WithLogger sets the logger. Logging is silent by default.

#### func WithMaxConnections

```go
func WithMaxConnections(n int) Option
```

WithMaxConnections limits the open CIP connections (Class 0, 1 and 3); Forward\_Open beyond it is refused with 0x01/0x0113. Default 128, at most 65535 (the Message Router reports it as a UINT).

#### func WithMaxConnectionsPerOriginator

```go
func WithMaxConnectionsPerOriginator(n int) Option
```

WithMaxConnectionsPerOriginator limits the open CIP connections (Class 0, 1 and 3) of one originator, by IP address, so that one originator cannot take every connection of WithMaxConnections; Forward\_Open beyond it is refused with 0x01/0x0113 (out of connections). Class 3 connections end with their session, I/O connections do not, so the originator, not the session, is what is counted. Default 0: no limit beyond WithMaxConnections (originators behind one NAT address share it).

#### func WithMaxPacket

```go
func WithMaxPacket(n int) Option
```

WithMaxPacket sets the largest encapsulation data length accepted; a session that sends a larger packet is closed. Default 4096, at most 65535.

#### func WithMaxSessions

```go
func WithMaxSessions(n int) Option
```

WithMaxSessions limits the registered sessions; RegisterSession beyond it is refused with insufficient memory. Default 64. It bounds the TCP connections too, registered or not: beyond 2\*n+16 a new connection is closed as soon as it is accepted.

#### func WithMetrics

```go
func WithMetrics(m ethernetip.Metrics) Option
```

WithMetrics sets the metrics callbacks; a value that also implements [ethernetip.ServerMetrics](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-ethernetip#ServerMetrics) or [ethernetip.IOMetrics](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-ethernetip#IOMetrics) receives those events too.

#### func WithRPIRange

```go
func WithRPIRange(min, max time.Duration) Option
```

WithRPIRange sets the requested packet intervals Forward\_Open accepts; others are refused with 0x01/0x0112. Default 1 ms to 1 hour.

#### func WithResetHandler

```go
func WithResetHandler(f func(resetType uint8) cip.GeneralStatus) Option
```

WithResetHandler sets the function the Identity object's Reset service calls with the reset type (0: emulate a power cycle, 1: return to factory defaults). It returns the status of the reply; without a handler Reset answers success and does nothing.

#### func WithRunIdleHeader

```go
func WithRunIdleHeader(consumed, produced bool) Option
```

WithRunIdleHeader sets the real-time formats of I/O connections: whether consumed (O->T) data carries the 32-bit run/idle header (default true) and whether produced (T->O) data does (default false).

#### func WithSlot

```go
func WithSlot(slot int) Option
```

WithSlot sets the backplane slot the server answers as: Unconnected\_Send routes and connection paths that address port 1 with this link are local. Default 0.

#### func WithTLS

```go
func WithTLS(cfg *tls.Config) Option
```

WithTLS serves EtherNet/IP over TLS, the CIP Security transport of explicit messages (port 2221). The configuration is used as given; require client certificates with ClientAuth.

### type Server

```go
type Server struct {

	// see jitter

	// every TCP connection, registered or not

	// pendingDiscovery counts the delayed UDP replies waiting in timers.

}
```

Server is an EtherNet/IP target (adapter): it accepts sessions on TCP, answers ListIdentity and ListServices on UDP, routes explicit requests to its objects through the Message Router, and opens Class 0, 1 and 3 connections for originators through its Connection Manager.

Create it with [New](#func-new), add assemblies and objects, then call [Server.ListenAndServe](#func-server-listenandserve) (or [Server.Listen](#func-server-listen) and [Server.Serve](#func-server-serve)). A Server is safe for concurrent use; objects and assemblies can be changed while it serves.

```go
func New(opts ...Option) (*Server, error)
```

New returns a server with the standard objects: Identity, Message Router, Assembly (without instances), Connection Manager, Port, TCP/IP Interface and Ethernet Link.

#### func (Server) Listen

```go
func (s *Server) Listen(addr string) error
```

Listen opens the server's sockets without serving them yet: the TCP listener on addr, a UDP socket on the same host and port (no error when it is taken, as by another server on the same host; ListIdentity is then served over TCP only), and the I/O endpoint.

#### func (Server) ListenAndServe

```go
func (s *Server) ListenAndServe(addr string) error
```

ListenAndServe listens on addr for TCP sessions, on the same host and port over UDP for ListIdentity and ListServices (44818 by default), and on the I/O address (WithIOAddress, default UDP port 2222 of the same host), and serves until Close. addr defaults to port 44818 (2221 with WithTLS) when it has no port. It returns ethernetip.ErrClosed after Close.

### type StandardObject

```go
type StandardObject struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

StandardObject is an [Object](#type-object) made of attributes and services: the class attributes 1 (revision), 2 (max instance), 3 (number of instances), 6 (max class attribute) and 7 (max instance attribute) are maintained, Get\_Attribute\_Single, Get\_Attributes\_All, Get\_Attribute\_List and Set\_Attribute\_Single work on the attributes, and further services are added with HandleService. It is safe for concurrent use; the attribute functions must be too.
